style: Clean casual mobile tower-defense key art in the style of Random Dice 2 and Kingdom Rush: bright saturated palette, smooth flat cel shading with soft gradients, thick clean outlines, rounded simplified chibi shapes, glossy polished cartoon look, minimal surface texture, crisp readable forms. No gritty realism, no painterly grain, no semi-realistic rendering, no dark muddy desaturation. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no border.

jobs.prompt: Vertical key art for a cheerful casual tower-defense game. A giant bright ivory die with bold red pips sits on top of a cute rounded stone castle keep with a red roof and a gold-trimmed blue banner, on a friendly green mountain peak. Sunny blue sky with soft fluffy clouds, warm golden glow, rolling green hills and a winding cobblestone path, a tidy pine forest below. Composition: the die and castle fill the upper two thirds, centered; the lower third is a soft bright valley with calm empty space reserved for UI. Bold simple shapes, high readability.

Wide key art for a cheerful casual tower-defense game. A giant bright ivory die with bold red pips sits on top of a cute rounded stone castle keep with a red roof and a gold-trimmed blue banner, exactly centered, on a friendly green mountain peak. Sunny blue sky with soft fluffy clouds and a warm golden glow, rolling green ridges and a tidy pine forest stretching left and right, a winding cobblestone path up the mountain. The lower quarter is a soft bright valley with calm empty space reserved for UI. Bold simple shapes, high readability.
